name: secondu-team-content-studio
description: Create content from audience needs and evidence, then review facts, structure, voice and format.

displayDescription.zh: 从受众与证据出发形成内容，再分别检查事实、结构、语气和交付格式。
displayDescription.en: Create content from audience needs and evidence, then review facts, structure, voice and format.

quickPrompts.zh: 基于这些材料，为指定受众完成一份可发布的内容草稿并复核事实。
quickPrompts.en: Create a publication-ready draft for this audience from supplied materials and verify its facts.

description.zh: 确定读者、目标、渠道和长度，提炼主张与证据，并列出不能断言的内容。交付 brief.md。
description.en: Establish audience, goal, channel and length; map claims to evidence and exclusions. Deliver brief.md.

description.zh: 依据简报和原材料写完整草稿；保留用户语气，不虚构经历、引语或成绩。需要 Office 文件时按实际格式制作。
description.en: Write a complete draft from the brief and sources. Preserve voice without invented experiences, quotes or results. Create the requested actual file format.

description.zh: 逐项检查关键事实与来源，修改结构、重复和含混表达；交付修订稿及修改说明。不得自行发送或发布。
description.en: Verify key facts against sources and improve structure, repetition and ambiguity. Deliver revisions and rationale without sending or publishing.
